mapper.update: update dating_recovery_run set finished_at=current_timestamp(3),status=#{status}, scanned=#{result.scanned},processed=#{result.processed},failed=#{result.failed}, record_failures=#{result.recordFailures},error_code=#{error} where run_id=#{id} and status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: select from dating_recovery_run where instance_id=#{instance} order by started_at desc,run_id desc limit 1
select from dating_recovery_run order by started_at desc,run_id desc

select coalesce(sum(case when status='READY' then 1 else 0 end),0) as ready, coalesce(sum(case when status='READY' and next_attempt_at <= current_timestamp then 1 else 0 end),0) as due, coalesce(sum(case when status='READY' and next_attempt_at <= #{overdueBefore} then 1 else 0 end),0) as overdue, coalesce(sum(case when status='ERROR' then 1 else 0 end),0) as errors, coalesce(sum(case when status='DONE' and outcome='BLOCKED' then 1 else 0 end),0) as blocked, coalesce(sum(case when status='DONE' and outcome='PENDING' then 1 else 0 end),0) as pending from dating_deduction_task
select count(*) from dating_recovery_run where status='RUNNING' and started_at <= #{staleBefore}
mapper.sql: (t.status='ERROR' or (t.status='DONE' and t.outcome='BLOCKED') or (t.status='READY' and (t.attempts>0 or t.next_attempt_at <= #{overdueBefore})))
p.progress not in ('SUCCESS_CLOSED','TERMINATED') and l.service_status<>'SUCCESS_CLOSED' and r.service_status<>'SUCCESS_CLOSED'
f.due_at is not null and f.due_at <= current_timestamp and
mapper.select:
select t.task_id,t.pair_id,t.user_id,t.status,t.outcome,t.attempts, (select h.error_code from dating_deduction_history h where h.task_id=t.task_id and h.action='FAILED' order by h.history_id desc limit 1) as error_code, pp.blocked_reason,t.next_attempt_at, (select min(h.create_time) from dating_deduction_history h where h.task_id=t.task_id and h.action='FAILED') as first_failure_at, (select max(h.create_time) from dating_deduction_history h where h.task_id=t.task_id and h.action='FAILED') as last_failure_at, l.name as low_name,r.name as high_name, case when t.user_id=p.user_low_id then l.name else r.name end as customer_name, case when t.user_id=p.user_low_id then coalesce(ls.nick_name,l.create_by) else coalesce(rs.nick_name,r.create_by) end as owner_name, p.progress as pair_progress, case when (t.status='ERROR' or (t.status='DONE' and t.outcome='BLOCKED')) and p.progress not in ('SUCCESS_CLOSED','TERMINATED') and l.service_status<>'SUCCESS_CLOSED' and r.service_status<>'SUCCESS_CLOSED' then true else false end as retry_allowed, coalesce(handler_user.nick_name,f.handler) as handler_name, coalesce(f.status,'UNASSIGNED') as handling_status,f.due_at, case when then true else false end as followup_overdue from dating_deduction_task t join dating_pair p on p.pair_id=t.pair_id join dating_pair_participant pp on pp.pair_id=t.pair_id and pp.user_id=t.user_id join sys_paying_user l on l.id=p.user_low_id join sys_paying_user r on r.id=p.user_high_id left join sys_user ls on ls.user_id=l.matchmaker_id left join sys_user rs on rs.user_id=r.matchmaker_id left join dating_exception_followup f on f.task_id=t.task_id left join sys_user handler_user on handler_user.user_name=f.handler where and t.pair_id=#{pairId} and t.status='ERROR' and t.status='DONE' and t.outcome='BLOCKED' and t.status='READY' and coalesce(f.status,'UNASSIGNED')=#{handling} and f.handler=#{mine} and
and ((case when l.matchmaker_id is null then l.create_by else ls.user_name end)=#{owner} or (case when r.matchmaker_id is null then r.create_by else rs.user_name end)=#{owner})
order by t.task_id desc
select history_id,task_id,action,attempt,error_code,create_by,create_time,reason from dating_deduction_history where task_id=#{taskId} order by history_id desc

select f.task_id,f.handler,coalesce(s.nick_name,f.handler) as handler_name, f.status,f.version,f.due_at,f.update_by,f.update_time from dating_exception_followup f left join sys_user s on s.user_name=f.handler where f.task_id=#{taskId}

select case when count(*)>0 then true else false end from dating_deduction_task t join dating_pair p on p.pair_id=t.pair_id join sys_paying_user l on l.id=p.user_low_id join sys_paying_user r on r.id=p.user_high_id where t.task_id=#{taskId} and and
select history_id,task_id,version,action,handler,status,due_at,note,create_by,create_time from dating_exception_followup_history where task_id=#{taskId} order by history_id desc
